description:
Restore a previously archived order in StarShipIt, returning it to the active fulfilment queue.

**When to use:** Use to undo an `starshipit_archive_order` call, re-activating an order so it can be fulfilled.

**Parameters:**
- `order_id` (required) — StarShipIt internal order ID to restore from archive

**Returns:** Confirmation message on success.

**Errors:** 404 if order not found or not currently archived; 401 if API keys invalid.

order_id.description: StarShipIt internal order ID to restore from archive

name: starshipit_restore_order

outputSchema.description: Raw StarShipIt API response; not truncated

errors.description: Validation or processing errors returned by StarShipIt

object.description: The response payload when StarShipIt returns a non-object value

success.description: StarShipIt success flag (a boolean on most endpoints)

title: Restore Order
